rows.en: Oh!? Speak of the pail... no, no, the devil, jan!
rows.notes: Witter mangles the speak-of-the-devil idiom with pail/bucket, then corrects himself; retain a spoken comic malapropism. Preserve recurring dawa/bari/jan comic suffix after reviewing neighboring packet0; Ginga explicitly comments on their speech in fresh72.
uncertain: English malapropism adapts Japanese bucket/shadow rhyme; comic equivalence is interpretive.

rows.en: Warning, warning. Multiple objects rapidly approaching the Hoshimi Town sector.
What!? Could they be remnants of the Hyakki Empire!?
Negative. Identified as Gulfer and Gyandlar.
G-Gyandlar!? Could they be after the Meteo Cube...!?
All hands, Level 1 battle stations! Dendoh and Ogre, prepare to deploy! Evacuate Hoshimi Town's residents to the shelters at once!
Roger!
The enemy is entering the Hoshimi Town sector.
...So this is Hoshimi Town... Dendoh and Ogre are here...
rows.notes: Subaru surveys Hoshimi; preserve trailing source thought without adding a capture plan.
uncertain: Source trailing omission retained.

rows.en: Subaru's here, dawa!
rows.notes: Preserve recurring dawa/bari/jan comic suffix after reviewing neighboring packet0; Ginga explicitly comments on their speech in fresh72.

rows.en: Let's hurry and hand over the white Gear Commander, bari!
rows.notes: Preserve recurring dawa/bari/jan comic suffix after reviewing neighboring packet0; Ginga explicitly comments on their speech in fresh72.

rows.en: ...Sheesh, why do we have to babysit that baldy and the kid?
rows.notes: Devil Saturn complains to Diondra about babysitting Zero and Subaru. Source baldy remains unnamed.

rows.en: Stop complaining. These are orders from Gades... Be patient until we get the Meteo Cube.
rows.notes: Drop honorific per frozen brief; deference remains in phrasing.

rows.en: Yeah, yeah, I know.
And... we'll settle things with that lot right here.
...It looks like this planet is headed for trouble, just like Planet Cronos.
rows.notes: Diondra alludes to future planetary trouble; do not supply its unstated cause.
uncertain: Source cause left unstated.

rows.en: I know that, too. I sure don't want to get sucked into that striped space again.
rows.notes: Devil Saturn recalls striped space; retain visual description without identifying a dimension.
uncertain: Nature of striped space is unspecified.

rows.en: Th-those guys... They've teamed up with the Gulfer again!?
Probably to steal the remaining Meteo Cube.
I get it. So they finally figured out that thing's here.
rows.notes: Ginga replies to Hokuto about the Cube; preserve source that thing rather than rename it.
uncertain: Source demonstrative retained.

rows.en: Y-yeah... Though I think a little thought would've made that obvious.
Subaru! We've brought you the white Gear Commander, bari!
rows.notes: Drop honorific per frozen brief; deference remains in phrasing. Preserve recurring dawa/bari/jan comic suffix after reviewing neighboring packet0; Ginga explicitly comments on their speech in fresh72.

rows.en: Well done. You may withdraw.
Understood, jan!
rows.notes: Preserve recurring dawa/bari/jan comic suffix after reviewing neighboring packet0; Ginga explicitly comments on their speech in fresh72.

rows.en: ...The white Gear Commander... With this, Ogre will be mine...
rows.notes: Subaru thinks of gaining Ogre with the stolen white Commander; retain trailing claim.
uncertain: Source trailing omission retained.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga! Hurry and call Ogre and Dendoh!!
All riiight! Dendoh, move out!!
Ogre, scramble!!
So you've appeared, Dendoh. But Ogre...!
rows.notes: Subaru notices Dendoh but not Ogre; keep interrupted contrasting thought.
uncertain: Source unfinished predicate retained.

rows.en: Hey, Hokuto! What are you doing!? Hurry and call Ogre!!
rows.notes: Ginga urgently tells Hokuto to call Ogre; restore command verb from preceding scramble calls.

rows.en: I-it won't start...! Ogre won't start up!!
W-what!?
What's going on!?
...Answer the voice of your rightful successor! Ogre!!
It moved...!? But why is it way over there!?
Chief, we've got a problem! Ogre has stopped in midair!!
What!?
What are you doing...? Come, Ogre... Come to me, your true master!
Ogre! Come over here!!
I-it isn't moving! What the hell's going on!?
Th-this is...! There are two accesses to Ogre's guidance system!!
rows.notes: Inoue reports two simultaneous accesses; do not add technical mechanism.

rows.en: Two!?
S-so someone besides me is calling Ogre!?
Could it be the white Gear Commander!?
That's impossible! It's being kept inside headquarters right now!
rows.notes: Inoue objects because HQ supposedly holds the white Commander; keep his mistaken belief before reveal. English assertion uses an exclamation; the source disbelief punctuation is not a grammatical question.

rows.en: It's just a precaution! Meteo, check at once!
...The white Gear Commander is in its designated location. No signs of a security breach.
rows.notes: Meteo reports false normal security status; do not explain Zero sabotage revealed in event11.

rows.en: What...!? Then who's calling Ogre, and how are they doing it!?
Where!? Can't you pinpoint the location of whoever's accessing it!?
P-please wait...!
I've found it! It's that Machine Knight!!
rows.notes: Eris locates the accessing Machine Knight; do not name Subaru before his self-reveal.
uncertain: Source identity omission retained: that Machine Knight.

rows.en: Ogre, you're mine...! So come to me!
It's being drawn over there...!? Ginga, stop Ogre!!
G-got it!!
Hmph, I won't let you! Finish them off!!
Gadessa!!
rows.notes: Gyandlar catchcry occurs twice, event4 and event11; retain spelling from campaign glossary.
uncertain: Gadessa is existing provisional phonetic catchcry; licensed English spelling unestablished.

rows.en: Tch, they got me! But just for today, even losing feels good!
rows.notes: Defeat/retreat event5: theft has already happened; event storage order is not chronological.

rows.en: After all, we got the Meteo Cube! Gahahahaha!!
rows.notes: Defeat/retreat event5: the Cube has already been obtained; do not soften the boast.

rows.en: Hehehe, you must've been furious at losing the Meteo Cube and Ogre...!
rows.notes: Defeat/retreat event5: Diondra taunts about completed thefts, not anticipation.

rows.en: But your fate is sealed... Now that Gades has it, you have no chance of winning!
rows.notes: Defeat/retreat event5: retain that/it demonstrative after Cube reference. Drop honorific per frozen brief; deference remains in phrasing.
uncertain: Source demonstrative retained.

rows.en: Hehehe, well done. I'd expect no less from those who defeated Spiral Castle...
rows.notes: Zero praises opponents in defeat/retreat event5, with courteous menace.

rows.en: I'll withdraw for today. ...I've obtained everything I wanted, after all.
rows.notes: Zero withdraws in defeat/retreat event5 after obtaining everything wanted.

rows.en: That Knight Ogre belongs to me, the Gulfer Emperor's son!! I won't let the likes of you have it!!
rows.notes: Event8 confrontation, Subaru explicitly reveals sonship; retain source-short Knight Ogre.

rows.en: The Gulfer Emperor's son!? You!?
You bastard, how the hell did you call Ogre!?
Of course, I used this white Gear Commander.
Quit lying! That's at GEAR HQ! Yours is a fake, isn't it!?
Then how do you explain my being able to draw Ogre toward me?
! D-don't tell me it's real...!?
Out of my way, you comedy robot! Hokuto... I'm getting Hokuto back!
rows.notes: Ginga addresses Devil Saturn 6; comedy-robot insult retained.

rows.en: Gyahahahaha! Such beautiful friendship! It brings tears to my eyes!
rows.notes: Mock sympathy and theatrical laughter are sarcastic.

rows.en: Shut up! You bastards... I'll never forgive you!!
What's wrong, little boy? Feeling down because we kidnapped your precious partner?
I'm taking you down and going after Hokuto! I don't have time to mope!!
rows.notes: Ginga will defeat current opponents then pursue abducted Hokuto; event8 conditional.

rows.en: You're late, Rom! I was sweating, thinking you'd show up at just the right moment, like always!
Even a hero of justice is useless if he's late! Gyahahahaha!
Silence! I'll repay this debt even if it costs me my life!!
rows.notes: Repay hostile debt means retaliation; vow preserved.

rows.en: Now that we have the Meteo Cube, we've no more business here...
But since we're here, I'll take you on, Rom!
Diondra! I'll defeat you all and settle things with Gades!!
Come, Dendoh. Now that Ogre is in our hands, you're of no further use. I shall bury you myself.
rows.notes: Event8 conditional: Ogre already captured, no premature event10 outcome.

rows.en: You bastard! If I lose here, who's going to save Hokuto!?
What does Gulfer plan to do with Hokuto now that you've kidnapped him!?
To Gulfer, GEAR and the Data Weapons are extremely dangerous.
Therefore, we shall take charge of them ourselves.
This Machine Beast... It's in a different league from the others...!
Oh... You can sense my power? That alone deserves praise.
This man... He's formidable...!
rows.notes: Source deliberate assessment separated by pause; supplied English subject/verb.

rows.en: Oh... A warrior of the Cronos tribe, and a master of Tenku Chushin Ken at that. To meet one here...
rows.notes: Deliberately trailing astonishment remains unfinished; no invented reaction.
uncertain: Deliberate trailing statement retained.

rows.en: I've heard the rumors... The Gulfer Emperor's trusted aide, spoken of in the same breath as Guard Captain Altair...!
rows.notes: Guard Captain Altair is the explicit comparison; trusted-aide metaphor rendered naturally.
uncertain: Guard Captain Altair is transparent source title; exact licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Indeed, Prince. My name is Zero... Remember it as a souvenir for the afterlife.
rows.notes: Threat retained as souvenir-for-afterlife idiom.

rows.en: So that is Earth's martial art, karate... Quite impressive.
Damn... He parried my attacks! This guy's really good!
Aiko, what's Ogre's status!?
It's still motionless!!
Come to me, Ogre!!
Ogre! Come to me!!
This is bad! At this rate, Ogre will lose its control balance and fall!
What!?
If we could somehow get aboard... Installing a command should block the other access...!!
rows.notes: Hypothetical boarding subject kept collective; installation rejects competing access, no mechanism added.
uncertain: Collective hypothetical we keeps unspecified boarding subject; scene subsequently settles Hokuto.

rows.en: Get aboard...!? That's it!
File Load! Unicorn Drill!!
Unicorn, carry me up to Ogre!
rows.notes: Source-short Unicorn retained.

rows.en: Hokuto!?
He's going to Ogre!?
rows.notes: Subaru reacts to Hokuto approaching Ogre; no future reveal.

rows.en: Ogre! Listen to me!!
No, Ogre! You're mine! Don't listen to him!!
Ogre! Oooogre!!
W-what!?
O-Ogre...!!
Won't you listen to me, Ogre!?
Now, Hokuto! Get inside Ogre!
Yeah!!
Hokuto! Install the command, quick!!
Command! Instaaaaall!!
W-we did it!!
The dual access to Ogre has been cleared!
Hokuto!!
Sorry I worried you! Everything's okay now, Ginga!
Well, well, little boy... He took Ogre from you. What are you going to do?
G-ghh...! What's going on...!? Was Zero lying to me!?
rows.notes: Subaru questions Zero promise, not an explanation of Ogre choice.

rows.en: Well, there you have it. Ogre chose that kid instead of you.
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 mocks Subaru after Ogre chose Hokuto.

rows.en: Shut up!!
Oh? Now you're lashing out at me? What a spoiled little brat.
rows.notes: Bocchan taunt rendered as spoiled little brat, without asserting literal wealth.

rows.en: Silence! You couldn't possibly understand how I feel!
Kid, let me tell you one thing. If there's something you want, take it by force.
rows.notes: Evil advice to Subaru retains forceful theft.

rows.en: That's what being a man... and being evil is all about. Well, you get it?
rows.notes: Deliberate pause links masculinity and evil; no moral softening.

rows.en: ...I don't need you to tell me that...!
Ogre is mine...! I won't hand it over to the likes of them!!
Well... It's almost time.
You got it! The main event's about to begin!
W-what's happening!?
Bulkheads 23 and 9 have been blown up by an unidentified party.
rows.notes: Unidentified perpetrator remains unidentified.

rows.en: Blown up!?
Warning. Warning. Explosion in the underground hangar... Intruder detected inside headquarters.
An intruder!?
N-no way!!
Those three weren't the only ones who'd sneaked inside!?
rows.notes: Hokuto asks about previously seen three infiltrators; no identity added.

rows.en: It's too dangerous to let this go on! Everyone, I'm counting on you to handle things here!
rows.notes: Vega asks others to cover outside while she responds within HQ.

rows.en: Whoa, whoa, look at you all rushing around. Well, you're already too late.
Damn it! The Gyandlar were a decoy!?
But planting that many explosives inside headquarters should be impossible without time to prepare...!
rows.notes: Inoue infers preparation time required; no invented explosive placement history.

rows.en: Then why didn't Meteo notice them!?
T-that's right...! It takes more than a halfhearted effort to breach Meteo's network...!
rows.notes: General difficulty of breaching network preserved without explaining cause.
uncertain: Halfhearted attempt renders namahanaka; breach difficulty is general, exact method unstated.

rows.en: Meteo, what happened to you!?

rows.notes: Meteo remains unresponsive; no invented cause.

rows.en: M-Meteo...!?
Hehehe... There's no point in asking.
rows.notes: Voice addresses Vega; identity is still hidden until row243.
uncertain: Hidden speaker retained as ???.

rows.en: Who are you!?
My name is Zero... Do remember it.
A human...!? No, you're Gulfer!
rows.notes: Shibuya realizes the intruder is Gulfer rather than human; restored subject addresses Zero.

rows.en: That is correct.
What have you done to Meteo!?
Heh... Princess Vega, you should know the answer.
rows.notes: Zero invokes Vega's royal identity to lead into the historical comparison.

rows.en: It's the same as when we Gulfer conquered Alktos seventeen years ago.
rows.notes: Conquest comparison, not an early claim that Meteo has been destroyed.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... You put Meteo into dormancy...!?
rows.notes: Vega infers dormancy; retained question and stammer.

rows.en: Though... As this was the second time, I could only put some of its functions into dormancy.
rows.notes: Zero qualifies that only some functions succumbed on the second attempt. This supersedes earlier ignorance, not an earlier false report.

rows.en: Th-then what happened to the white Gear Commander!?
I seized it. It is now in our hands.
...Now, unlike Spiral Castle, I do not much care for roundabout methods.
Allow me to settle this in one stroke, here and now.
No! Begin evacuating all personnel except Class A staff!!
rows.notes: Class A personnel are excluded from evacuation; no rank or robot-class inference.

rows.en: Y-yes!
Now, prepare yourselves...
Hm!?
Zero...!!
rows.notes: Hidden voice challenges Zero; Altair identity is not supplied in the speaker field until source reveals it.
uncertain: Hidden speaker retained as ???.

rows.en: Altair... Oh, you...
rows.notes: Deliberately interrupted source after you; English remains unfinished.
uncertain: Source interruption retained.

rows.en: It's been a long time. Though this is the first time we've met in our present forms.
rows.notes: Altair contrasts the current appearances with the earlier encounter while piloting Ogre.

rows.en: Yes. You were aboard Ogre back then, after all.
Brother!!
rows.notes: Brother addresses Altair; explicit kinship retained.

rows.en: Vega, go with Hokuto and the others and recover the white Gear Commander!!
rows.notes: Altair instructs Vega to retrieve the white Commander with Hokuto and others; direction preserved.

rows.en: What will you do, Brother!?
rows.notes: Family address is meaningful kinship rather than a suffix honorific; retained Brother.

rows.en: I'll stay here and buy time until everyone escapes!
Heh, I cannot allow that. ...I have a promise to keep to them, too.
rows.notes: Them anticipates the newly arriving separate force; retain demonstrative rather than reveal identities early.
uncertain: Source demonstrative retained.

rows.en: What?!
rows.notes: Source meaning rendered as spoken battle dialogue; settled subject/action restored where needed.

rows.en: Damn, a separate force!
Hehehe... At last, the moment has come...!
Gades, watch! Now we shall claim a new Hyribead, the Meteo Cube, for ourselves!!
rows.notes: Ashura claims Meteo Cube as a new Hyribead; no extra energy mechanics.

rows.en: Oh no! From that position, Meteo will...!!
rows.notes: Threat to Meteo deliberately trails off; no invented destruction or final fate.
uncertain: Source interruption retained.

rows.en: Ginga, you go down there too! I'll handle the enemies here!!
Yeah!!
rows.notes: Ginga agrees forcefully.

rows.en: ...I will not let you do that.
We're surrounded!?
D-damn it! These bastards!!
rows.notes: Angry outburst directed at surrounding enemies; source deliberately ends in a deictic fragment.
uncertain: Source exclamatory fragment retained.

rows.en: Let go! Let go of me!! You bastards!!
Hokuto! Ginga!!
rows.notes: Bridge prepares for battleship crash; support pilots recognize Dendoh escaping.  Preserved source fragment, silence, vocative or interjection; no missing English grammatical subject was introduced.

rows.en: Now, Ashura... Fulfill your ambition.
Hmph, you don't need to tell me!
Ah! The command room bulkhead!!
rows.notes: Exclamation about the bulkhead retains source fragment without inventing its exact damage.
uncertain: Source exclamatory fragment retained.

rows.en: A-are they going to come in here!?
I won't let you!
Ngh!?
I will not let you reach Meteo.
Damn you, Zero...!
If you think you can kill me and die with me, you are wasting your time... Altair.
rows.notes: Mutual killing attempt, not merely attacking Zero. Altair's own death remains explicit.

rows.en: Are you sure? Today, I just might manage it.
However strong their resolve, humans are fragile creatures.
That form...!!
rows.notes: Altair reacts to a changed form; no form name introduced ahead of source.
uncertain: Source exclamatory fragment retained.

rows.en: This is the end, Altair.
B-Brotherrrr!!
rows.notes: Source name-call, cry, shock or incomplete phrase retained intentionally.

rows.en: Oh, so this is Meteo. The Meteo Cube is beneath it, if I recall correctly?
rows.notes: Meteo Cube beneath Meteo; retain question and recollection.

rows.en: Yes, that is correct.
Y-you...!!
rows.notes: Shibuya addresses the intruder with an angry unfinished outburst.
uncertain: Source exclamatory fragment retained.

rows.en: Ah... Aaah...!
Well then, it's time for checkmate!
rows.notes: Proofreading: natural phrasing; no measured-fit compression.

rows.en: Meteo!!
Gwahahahaha! At last... At last, the Meteo Cube is mine!!
Now the No. 1 spot in the Commander Ranking belongs to the great Ashura foreverrr!!
rows.notes: Self-glorifying Ashura boast and permanent No.1 Commander position retained. Coordinator final: fixed central Commander Ranking label, same source singular ranking; no compression.

rows.en: You just showed up late and grabbed all the glory...!
At this point, I don't care how we do it, as long as we get the Meteo Cube.
Besides, we can just take their spot in the rankings later.
rows.notes: Ashura referent known, but sourced gender unknown; avoid masculine pronoun. Proofreading: natural phrasing; no measured-fit compression.

rows.en: ...With a trap, an assassination, or whatever it takes. That's what evil is all about, right?
rows.notes: Retain trap and assassination alternatives and explicit evil worldview.

rows.en: Th-that's our Big Sis... You're absolutely right.
rows.notes: Anego is established character nickname Big Sis, not a decorative name suffix.

rows.en: Now then, it's about time we finished up.
If we dawdle, someone might turn up to interfere.
Oh, come to think of it, that idiot never showed up.
rows.notes: That idiot stays source-short. Later context points to Rom, without inserting the name.
uncertain: Source-short referent retained.

rows.en: People would get bored if he did the same old routine every time, wouldn't they?
rows.notes: Comedic metacommentary about the repetitive entrance routine. He refers to the absent idiot, revealed as Rom in later source.

rows.en: Come on, Ashura! Hurry up and take the Meteo Cube to Gades!
Right! I'm leaving the rest to you!
rows.notes: Ashura entrusts the remaining operation to Diondra, not vice versa.

rows.en: I won't let you escape!!
Oh dear, you don't seem to understand your current situation very well.
How do you propose to chase them in your present state?
rows.notes: Pursuit target is Ashura; avoid unsupported gender even though source uses kare. Proofreading: natural phrasing; no measured-fit compression.

rows.en: Ghh!!
Well then... Shall we take the other item as well?
rows.notes: Keep other item unrevealed until capture follows.
uncertain: Source demonstrative retained.

rows.en: Huh!?
...Subaru.
Yes, I know. Capture Machine Beast, we're taking Ogre back with us.
rows.notes: Subaru orders Capture Machine Beast to return with Ogre. No added capture technology.

rows.en: H-Hokuto!!
Now Ogre is mine...!
Hokuto! Hokutooooo!!
Th-that bastard!! He planned to do that to Hokuto and Ogre from the start!?
rows.notes: Ginga realizes the original intent to abduct Hokuto and Ogre, confirmed by following rows320..321. Retain source-short do that rather than adding omitted mechanism.
uncertain: Source demonstrative retained.

rows.en: Yes. That is why I did not destroy Meteo when I stole the white Gear Commander.
rows.notes: Zero confirms Ginga's accusation of preplanned abduction. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: To obtain Knight Ogre, its chosen pilot, and the black Gear Commander all at once.
rows.notes: Zero names all three targets of the simultaneous acquisition. Purpose clause answers 320; preserve chosen pilot and both named objects.
uncertain: Source omission or deliberate fragment retained; see notes.

rows.notes: Nonverbal exclamation retained exactly as ASCII punctuation.

rows.en: Hmph. That guy has quite a knack for scheming.
rows.notes: Bug comments on Zero's cunning after hearing his plan. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns. Proofreading removes an unsupported stronger insult; no fit-driven shortening.

rows.en: Daaamn it! Hokuto...!! Give Hokuto back, you bucket-headed bastard!!
rows.notes: Ginga demands Zero return Hokuto, shouting in fury. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... And now, you and GEAR headquarters shall be erased...
rows.notes: Zero threatens the defenders and their headquarters. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: All forces, begin the attack!
rows.notes: Zero commands all forces to attack; reused Gadesser shout follows. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: You idiot! You don't have to follow his orders!
rows.notes: Diondra rebukes Devil Saturn 6 for obeying Zero. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: S-sorry...! Force of habit. I just wasn't thinking.
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 apologizes to Diondra for the reflexive response. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: I've got to... I've got to do something, or we'll really all be wiped out...!!
rows.notes: Vega desperately considers how to prevent total annihilation. Restore I as actor and we as endangered group; thought brackets counted.

rows.en: #部隊名...! You've come to help us!?
rows.notes: Vega addresses the arriving allied squad. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Vega, are you all right!?
rows.notes: Misato checks Vega's condition. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: M-Misato...! H-Hokuto and Ogre... the Gulfer...!!
rows.notes: Vega tries to tell Misato about Hokuto and Ogre's capture. Retain source interruption; 332 supplies completed abduction report.
uncertain: Source omission or deliberate fragment retained; see notes.

rows.en: What!?
Those Gulfer bastards took them away!!
rows.notes: Ginga completes Vega's report for Misato. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: W-what did you say!?
rows.notes: Kazuya reacts in shock to the abduction report. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Th-that's not all...! The Gyandlar even stole the Meteo Cube...!!
rows.notes: Vega reports the additional loss of the Meteo Cube. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Leina reacts to the stolen Cube. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: I-is that true!?
rows.notes: Jim asks whether the theft report is true. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry... We weren't strong enough to protect them...
rows.notes: Vega apologizes for the defenders' inability to protect their charges. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: ...Vega, you have nothing to blame yourself for.
rows.notes: Rom reassures Vega that she need not blame herself. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: We just have to take back what they stole. Hokuto, Knight Ogre... and the Meteo Cube, too.
rows.notes: Rom says the stolen captives and Cube can be recovered. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: R-Rom...!
rows.notes: Vega responds emotionally to Rom's reassurance. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: For now, we must drive off the Gyandlar and Gulfer here!
rows.notes: Rom redirects attention to repelling the present enemies. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: All units, launch immediately!!
rows.notes: Misato orders immediate allied deployment. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Heh... The whole cast is here, it seems. Allow me to entertain you for a while.
rows.notes: Zero welcomes the reinforcements with a theatrical taunt. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Rom Stol, it's nearly time for you lot to leave the stage!
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 taunts Rom Stol about his approaching defeat. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: That's my line, Devil Saturn 6! We won't let you do as you please any longer!!
rows.notes: Rom answers Devil Saturn 6, denying the enemies further free rein. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: W-wait, damn you!!
rows.notes: Ginga shouts after retreating enemies. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Linda! Track the enemy units!!
rows.notes: Misato tells Linda to track the fleeing enemy units. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: I-I can't! We've lost them!
rows.notes: Linda reports losing the enemy track. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: D-damn it!! Give Hokuto back... Give him baaack!!
rows.notes: Ginga despairingly demands Hokuto's return. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: You goddamn idiooooot!!
rows.notes: Extended furious curse directed at Leo; goddamn idiot preserves emphatic force and elongated shout.

rows.en: G-Ginga...
rows.notes: Eris responds to Ginga's distressed outburst. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: Hokuto and Ogre... and even the Meteo Cube have all been taken...
rows.notes: Vega thinks of all three losses in the failed defense. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: ...What... What will become of our future now...?
rows.notes: Vega worries about the allies' future after the losses. Natural spoken register; explicit subjects supplied from adjacent source turns.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry, Captain Bright. If you hadn't come, who knows what would have become of us...
rows.notes: Shibuya apologizes and thanks Bright for the timely reinforcement. Explicit rank rendered Captain Bright per character-specific project direction.
